data.title: 伊雷娜 · 雨天书店
data.description: 雨水在旧书店玻璃上汇成细流，伊雷娜披着短款深蓝防水斗篷，里面是象牙白毛衣与深灰百褶裙，仍戴着金扣黑魔女帽。她坐在窗边矮椅上，左手托住摊开的魔法书，右手翻页；合拢的雨伞斜靠在椅脚，窗台放着陶杯与干燥的书页书签。身后齐腰书柜通向窄过道，窗外可见滴水遮篷下的湿石街。左侧阴天窗光柔和地照亮书页与银发，右后方原有店灯给木书脊添上暖色，椅腿和伞尖在地板留下接触阴影——「既然一时走不了，就在这里读一会儿书吧。这样的旅途插曲也不错呢。」
data.location: 旧书店临窗矮椅，后方矮书柜通向窄过道，窗外为雨中石街
data.action: 左手托着摊开的魔法书，右手翻页；合拢雨伞靠在椅脚，双手不持伞。
data.lighting: overcast window light from the left with warm bookstore lamps behind to the right
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, book, resting umbrella, wet window and bookcase visible
data.promptProse: Rain gathers into thin rivulets on the pane beside Elaina's low reading chair. Her short navy rain cape rests over an ivory sweater and charcoal pleated skirt; the gold-buckled black witch hat stays on her head. She supports an open spellbook with her left hand and turns a page with her right. A closed umbrella leans against the chair leg, and a ceramic cup and dry paper bookmark sit on the sill. Waist-high bookcases lead into a narrow aisle behind her; through the glass, a dripping awning shelters the edge of a wet cobblestone street. Frame the book and her peaceful face together at eye level. Cool overcast light from the left spreads across paper and silver hair, balanced by warm shop lamps behind to the right. Chair legs and umbrella tip cast small contact shadows on the floor.
